items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You never run into a horn player by the name of Jabbo Smith, did you? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yes, I did. Sure.

ctx.x: Charlie Johnson, that's right. Small's Paradise on 135th, I think it is, 135th and 7th.
You never run into a horn player by the name of Jabbo Smith, did you? Oh, I knew Jabbo. You did?
